name: jpm-payments-skills
description: J.P. Morgan Payments developer-experience marketplace. Distributes the jpm-payments-skills plugin (onboarding intake, OAuth code generation, Checkout / Online Payments integration, and in-store semi-integrated terminal integration) for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.

plugins.name: jpm-payments-skills
plugins.description: Conversational agent skills that walk a merchant from J.P. Morgan Payments onboarding through a working API integration. Covers online Checkout and Online Payments, plus in-store semi-integrated terminal integration on Ingenico AXIUM terminals. Generates language-specific OAuth modules (Node/TypeScript, Python, Java idiomatic; other languages via canonical algorithm).
